title: Mien fingerprint spec
description: Machine-readable companion to docs/specs/fingerprint-engine/SPEC.md. The SPEC remains normative.

hardware_concurrency.description: Realistic core count for the persona platform. The allowed set is data-driven: validate against the installed kernel manifest flags.fingerprint-hardware-concurrency.per_platform_values, not against a hard-coded list here.

window.description: Canonical window size. This is the only place window size is stored: it is not duplicated in runtime preferences, profile responses or exports. Window size only, never a screen resolution.

spoof.description: Per-category spoof toggles: true means the category is spoofed, false disables it for this profile and maps to `--disable-spoofing`. Omitted categories and an omitted object default to enabled. Only categories declared by the installed kernel capability manifest may appear; unsupported categories are rejected rather than silently dropped (REQ-FP-011). Disabling every supported category produces an explicit warning.

disable_non_proxied_udp.description: Stored specs always carry the effective value; false is an advanced unsafe setting requiring explicit confirmation and an audit action before persistence.
